categories.label: Chandeliers
categories.seoTitle: Handcrafted Crystal Chandeliers · Made in Firozabad · Samrat Glass Emporium
categories.metaDescription: Hand-blown crystal chandeliers for Indian foyers, dining rooms and banquet halls. Multi-tier, single-tier and three-arm designs available for pre-order in Firozabad since 1981.
categories.intro: Our chandeliers are the centrepiece of every home we help design — hand-blown crystal drops, hand-cut glass arms, and finishes that range from ruby-red antique brass to aged copper and gilt gold. Every piece is assembled in Firozabad, where our karigars have been shaping decorative glass since 1981. Choose from soaring multi-tier chandeliers for double-height foyers and banquet halls, sculptural single-tier statement pieces for dining rooms, or delicate three-arm designs sized for Indian apartments. Popular finishes include gilt brass, antique bronze, matte black and polished nickel; popular glass profiles include crystal prism, cut-glass diamond, scallop crown and pinecone drop. Every chandelier is available for pre-order — production and dispatch timelines are confirmed after enquiry.

categories.label: Hanging Lights
categories.seoTitle: Hanging Lights & Pendants · Handcrafted in Firozabad · Samrat Glass Emporium
categories.metaDescription: Bell pendants, hurricane hangings, brass lanterns and decorative cluster lights for kitchens, dining rooms and staircases. Hand-assembled in Firozabad, available for pre-order.
categories.intro: Hanging lights are the workhorse of luxury Indian lighting — from single-pendant clusters over kitchen islands to bell-shaped brass lanterns above staircase landings and dining tables. Each fixture in this collection is hand-assembled in our Firozabad atelier using traditional glass-blowing techniques passed down through three generations. Choose amber-tinted hurricane pendants for restaurants and lounges, smoked-glass domes for modern homes, hand-etched patterns for temples and heritage villas, or minimal clear-glass bells for contemporary flats. Chain, rod and cable suspensions are available in gilt brass, antique bronze, brushed nickel and matte black. Every hanging light is available for pre-order — we finalise dimensions, cord length and voltage after your enquiry so the piece fits your ceiling and load-bearing spec exactly.

categories.label: Wall Lights
categories.seoTitle: Wall Lights & Sconces · Handcrafted Glass Lighting · Samrat Glass Emporium
categories.metaDescription: Cut-glass sconces, twin-arm brackets, tulip shades and heritage wall lights for hallways, staircases, dressing tables and reading nooks. Available for pre-order in Firozabad.
categories.intro: Wall lights and sconces add warmth to hallways, dressing tables, staircases and reading nooks without occupying floor space. Our collection spans classic Anglo-Indian wall brackets in cut-glass and gilt brass, contemporary etched glass tulips, mid-century flute sconces and ornate diamond-cut luster shades. Every piece is hand-assembled in Firozabad by our karigars, who specialise in the delicate finish work that distinguishes premium wall lights from mass-market fittings. Popular pairings include matched wall-and-ceiling sets for dining rooms and coordinated multi-light installations for staircases. Available in single-arm, twin-arm and cluster configurations. All wall lights are available for pre-order — production and dispatch timelines are confirmed after enquiry, and installation guidance is provided over WhatsApp.

categories.label: Table Lamps
categories.h1: Table Lamps for Consoles, Studies & Bedsides
categories.seoTitle: Table Lamps · Hand-Blown Glass & Brass Bases · Samrat Glass Emporium
categories.metaDescription: Etched hurricane lamps, brass-base study lights and bedside table lamps handcrafted in Firozabad. Available for pre-order with confirmed shade colour, base finish and switch type.
categories.intro: Table lamps for the Indian home need to do more than light a corner — they need to hold their own on a console, a study desk or a bedside cabinet. This collection features hand-etched glass shades, hand-turned solid brass bases, cut-glass hurricanes and traditional oil-lamp silhouettes reimagined for modern homes. Every piece is assembled in our Firozabad workshop, where the glasswork is done in-house. Popular styles include the ruby-red etched hurricane, the frosted-floral bedside lamp and the classic tulip-shade reading light. Finishes range from antique brass to aged bronze, gilt gold and polished nickel. All table lamps are available for pre-order — we confirm shade colour, base finish and switch type after your enquiry so the piece matches your interior perfectly.

categories.label: Floor Lamps
categories.seoTitle: Floor Lamps · Heritage Brass & Glass Statement Lights · Samrat Glass Emporium
categories.metaDescription: Multi-tier column lamps, Ottoman lantern trees and heritage tall-brass floor lamps for luxury villas, hotels and premium showrooms. Available for pre-order in Firozabad.
categories.intro: Floor lamps in the Samrat Glass Emporium collection are traditional Indian statement pieces — multi-tier column lamps, Ottoman-inspired lantern trees and heritage tall-brass designs commonly seen in luxury hotels, private villas and premium showrooms. Each floor lamp is hand-assembled in Firozabad on a solid brass or cast-iron base for stability, with hand-blown or hand-etched glass shades sourced from the same atelier that produces our chandeliers. Popular styles include the three-tier mosaic globe lamp, the Ottoman lantern tree with hand-painted glass and the classic single-shade reading lamp. Finishes include antique brass, aged bronze and polished gold. All floor lamps are available for pre-order — production and dispatch timelines are confirmed after enquiry.

categories.label: Candle Stands
categories.seoTitle: Candle Stands & Hurricane Covers · Handcrafted Glass · Samrat Glass Emporium
categories.metaDescription: Crystal hurricane shades, brass candelabras and heritage candle stands for dining tables, mantelpieces, temples and weddings. Handmade in Firozabad, available for pre-order.
categories.intro: Candle stands and hurricane covers are the finishing touch on any luxury dining table, mantelpiece, temple altar or wedding-ceremony setup. Our collection features hand-cut crystal hurricane shades, hand-etched frosted-glass columns and classic three-arm brass candelabras finished in gilt gold and antique bronze. Every piece is produced in Firozabad using traditional glasswork techniques dating back to 1981 — the same techniques that go into our chandeliers and hanging lights. Popular pairings include matched candle-stand-and-hurricane sets for banquets and hotel restaurants, and single-piece heritage stands for private homes and temples. Available in single, double, triple and multi-tier configurations. All candle stands are available for pre-order — production and dispatch timelines are confirmed after enquiry.
